Results.ReviewText:
We received grill all put together from Ace Hardware on Limeport Pike in the Lehigh.Valley, Pa.   Nice cooking space. 
Like that tank is stored behind closed doors!
Results.Title: Positive points Re:E-210 spirit grill from Weber!

Results.ReviewText: I bought our Spirit E-210 just before Memorial Day. I went with the smaller grill as there's only two of us most of the time. However, I found that when the whole family is here with grandkids (10) the grill has plenty of room for all of our grilling foods. It's easy to operate, heats up quickly and grills perfectly. I really enjoy grilling on it. The side tables fold down when not it use, so the grill doesn't take a lot of room up on the deck. I highly recommend this grill. Can't say enough good things about it - love it!
Results.Title: Love this great grill!

Results.ReviewText: Heats evenly and cooks food well. Nice size for small deck and two people. Came with small back cabinet panel not like display model in store. Called customer service for replacement part. Had trouble understanding foreign representative but received correct part. Made in USA worth the higher price!
Results.Title: First time Weber buyer.

Results.ReviewText: It's holding up long term outdoors without a cover. It doesn't cook evenly. The back is burnt and the front isn't finished. It also really flares up when cooking frozen burger patties. I assume they are 20% fat at the least.
Results.Title: Well it's holding up, but

Results.ReviewText: So far I’m really enjoying the BBQ. It cooks evenly with consistent heat. My only complaint is the stability. When cleaning with the usual BBQ wire brush, the unit itself moves around quite a bit. Only having 2 locking wheels just isn’t enough to keep steady when cleaning the grills. A small complaint but a bit an annoying.
Results.Title: Good BBQ

Results.ReviewText: Weber grills are the best. Great warranty and wonderful customer service! Thank you this is my 6th Weber. Some were gifts.
Results.Title: Great value.

Results.ReviewText: We really love our Weber Grill. It cooks evenly and it is great.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: I purchased one just like it back in 2016. I still have it and use it. I had to replace the heat shields a couple of times. In the burner other than that, it works great and I keep it shiny clean.
Results.Title: If you purchase it, you’ll have it for a long time

Results.ReviewText: A very dependable grill. It lights every time. Great temperature control. I assembled the grill in 45 minutes by myself m
Results.Title: Terrific grill. No complaints

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback is important to us. We are sorry to hear you received your grill with a broken hose and regulator. Our Care Team will follow up to make sure this has been resolved. Please look for an outreach from us soon. Thank you!
ClientResponses.Name: Consumer Care

Results.ReviewText: We received our Weber with a broken regulator.  It was delivered by Lowes fully assembled. Now, they want us to return it and get a new one.  Dah...I had it delivered for a reason
Results.Title: broken regulator

Results.ReviewText: My last Weber grill lasted over 20 years. When I was given this one, it was still going strong and I gave my old one to a friend. This grill is awesome. I would not purchase anything other than a Weber grill. The quality is top notch and it cooks fantastic.
Results.Title: Weber is THE BEST

Results.ReviewText: This BBQ is excellent.  Very happy with our purchase.  Works very well.  We have been thinking to purchase a Weber BBQ for couple of years, we are glad we decided to get it.  Works very well.
Results.Title: Best BBQ

Results.ReviewText: Have always wanted a Weber because I have heard nothing but good things . I work at Lowe’s at the customer service desk and I can’t remember when a Weber has been returned . I purchased this a month ago and assembled it myself . Been cooking for a few weeks and it is truly the best grill I have ever owned. Cooks evenly and it is a solid unit. Highly recommend the webers !!
Results.Title: Fan for life.

Results.ReviewText: Putting the grill together was a bit of a chore as the directions were mostly pictures.  Mistakes were made but we got there.  The grill is great for cooking and the quality appears very good.  The propane tank gauge is a spring which is not calibrated very well and so a full tank is reading half.
Results.Title: Great grill, poor setup directions, bad tank gauge

Results.ReviewText: Works beautifully. Holds  temp.better than older Weber.
Results.Title: Top GRILL

Results.ReviewText: Great grill!  I had the three burner, but left it when I moved. This two burner just the perfect size!  Love Weber grills!
Results.Title: Weber 2 Burner Propane Grill

Results.ReviewText: This grill cooks very evenly and does really good with low too no flame up.
Results.Title: Grill works great

Results.ReviewText: Does what you ask of it. Made from seemingly durable materials. I hope to have this for many years and give it 5 stars!
Results.Title: This could be the one!

Results.ReviewText: It’s good but lacks storage area space. The closed area mainly occupied by the gas bottle. Otherwise all good. Lighting and performance is very good.
Results.Title: Storage area cramped!

Results.ReviewText: Food in the middle of the grill doesn’t cook well. Grill doesn’t maintain its temperature. Very disappointed
Results.Title: Uneven heat

Results.ReviewText: Great grill in a small space. My 2nd floor deck has a lot of furniture so this grill is a perfect size
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill!! It’s perfect for 1-4 people. With the warming racks-those are great for hot dog/hamburger buns. The grill was a gift to me but was easy to assemble with two people.
Results.Title: Love this grill

Results.ReviewText: This is a brand new purchase.   We have waited for several years for this purchase.   So far (approximately 2 weeks or so old).  We are learning to master it every time we cook.    Last night we cooked asparagus and they were outstanding.   Steak is so much better outside.
Results.Title: N/a

Results.ReviewText: At first I just thought a grill is a grill! This grill cooks so nice with even heat and the indirect heat area is a massive need. Lowest temp I could obtain is 225° for slow and low and I can’t complain at all. Honestly just buy one and don’t look back, this thing makes grillin so much easier.
Results.Title: Wasn’t a believer either!

Results.ReviewText: I appreciate good workmanship and presentation. My new Weber grill seems to be very well-made and the packaging of the grill itself and the many parts included was very well done. It’s quite a process to put this grill together, but Weber made that process very organized and complete. The grill itself is a perfect fit for two people, and it will allow me to also serve my growing brood of grandchildren. I also like the surface on the grill plates themselves, as they seem easy to clean.
Results.Title: Perfect Fit

Results.ReviewText: Cooking seams very even, works great for a 2 burner. Only disappointment is that it was delivered with scratches
Results.Title: Pretty Good

Results.ReviewText: One of the best Grills out there. Only down fall is Flavorizers need to be replaced often as pin holes and rust form quickly.
Results.Title: The Best Grill, second to none.

Results.ReviewText: We have owned many a grille whether it be gas, Charcoal, smoker and pellet.   This grille is super easy to use, gets hot in minutes and everything we cook is delicious.  Must have
Results.Title: Must have.

Results.ReviewText: This is a very well made grill that should last for many years.
Results.Title: Built to last.

Results.ReviewText: Very nice grill, easy to read manual and the App is great for pulling grilling instructions, recipes and more. Very happy with it.
Results.Title: Very nice grill!

Results.ReviewText: Excellent….easy to use….easy to clean….highly efficient….thoroughly enjoy it…a great purchase
Results.Title: Spirit E-210

Results.ReviewText: We love this grill! It’s easy to cook on as it doesn’t get so hot that you char everything! It is also easy to clean up afterwards.
Results.Title: Great value for the price

Results.ReviewText: Had a Weber Genesis Silver for 23 years. The raccoons tore the bottom drip tray off along with the rails, so a new grill was required. Saw the Spirit E-210 and liked the door on the front, which would keep wildlife out and purchased it. Have only used it twice but really like it!! It heats up faster than the old one and cooks very well and quickly. I am looking forward to many years of service with this grill.
Results.Title: Hopefully Wildlife Proof!!

Results.ReviewText: Top quality grill, for sure.  You can buy the cheap stuff but you get whay you pay for.
Results.Title: You get what you pay for

46110001.Name: Spirit E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
